description: This file defines the 'Sale' class, representing a sale record in an online grocery ordering system, including fields for order details, constructors, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Represents a sale transaction with attributes like order ID, date, amount, status, address, customer ID, product ID, and a potential DPID.

methods.name: Sale (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a Sale object with complete details including order ID, date, amount, status, address, customer ID, product ID, and optional DPID.

methods.name: Sale (overloaded constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a Sale object with basic details: order ID, date, amount, and address.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the delivery address for the sale.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets or updates the delivery address for the sale.

methods.name: getOrderDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the order.

methods.name: getTotalAmount
methods.description: Returns the total amount of the sale.

methods.name: isOrderStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the order (e.g., completed or pending).

methods.name: getCusID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the customer who placed the order.

methods.name: getPID
methods.description: Returns the product ID associated with the sale.

methods.name: getDPID
methods.description: Returns the DPID, which may represent a delivery person ID or related entity.

methods.name: setTotalAmount
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the sale.
